text:
Maria Chen: FYI Nebula (new semantic search) rolled to prod last night and were seeing a ~3x token increase. Need a concise QBR slide: root cause, 30d spend scenarios, and 3 concrete asks for the account team. Who picks up the telemetry?
Priya Singh: Ill take telemetry and model-variant split. Will export per-endpoint tokens + p95 latency by EOD.
Jonah Lee: Ill run spend scenarios (baseline / ramp / peak) and compute impact on renewal health. Need any promo credits on file.
Carlos Mendez: Ill prepare an enablement checklist for their engs: context window trimming, client-side batching, response dedupe, and an emb-quant fallback. Can also draft a short rollback plan.
Maria Chen: They reported embedding p95 ~520ms and intermittent 504s at peak. Please flag a product ticket for the latency regression.
Priya Singh: Quick SQL I ran to validate:
```sql
SELECT route, model_variant, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id='nebula' AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route, model_variant;
```
Priya Singh: Early numbers: embeddings route ~80% of tokens; emb-large p95 ~520ms; emb-quant-lite used <3% of calls.
Jonah Lee: Forecasts (prelim):
- baseline: +30% next 30d
- ramp: +70% next 30d
- peak: +150% next 30d if activity stays the same and no throttles.
Jonah Lee: Uploading nebula_forecast_scenarios.csv to the shared drive now.
Maria Chen: Proposed QBR asks: 1) one-time buffer credits (recommend 2.5k) to avoid account churn, 2) short soft-rate limit on embeddings route, 3) enable emb-quant-lite as automatic fallback when p95 > 350ms.
Carlos Mendez: Sample throttle config for ops:
```json
{"route":"/v1/embeddings","limit_tokens_per_min":200000,"fallback":"emb-quant-lite-v1","alert_on":"p95>350ms"}
```
Carlos Mendez: Also adding a tiny SDK snippet showing client batching + dedupe heuristics to the enablement doc.
Priya Singh: Ill open ticket linking route CSV and will add a short runbook to flip fallback on during incidents. Ticket #CS-2042.
qbr-bot: Reminder: QBR slides are due in #qbr-drafts by Thu 09:00 PST.
Maria Chen: @Jonah please confirm the 2.5k ask by EOD so I can lock the deck.
Jonah Lee: Confirmed. I modeled amortization and 2.5k covers ~30 days under ramp; uploaded amortization_breakdown.csv.
Priya Singh: Done - route CSV attached to CS-2042 (nebula_route_30d_tokens.csv).
Carlos Mendez: Scheduled a 25m enablement with Nebula engs for Wed 11:00 PT and shared the quick checklist.
Maria Chen: Great work team. Ill assemble the slide and include the product latency ticket link. Closing thread unless any blockers.
